name: Silt Strider default acquisition policy
notes: Authored rules, versioned independently of any extraction snapshot.
Changing a rule here never requires re-extracting the game data.
Thresholds are stated once; the evaluator derives numbers from the game.
Worn gear is priced pro rata: a CellRef condition of 2 of 300 is worth 27 gold.
Broken gear counts: condition 0 is free and repairable, so it is a route, not protection. The optimizer must repair before it is armour.
The gold cap applies to purchases only. Theft that clears the danger and lock rules has no price limit, because nothing is being paid.
Samarys is a starting-area place: the benchmark item must pass its own benchmark.
excludedCells lists exact keys: a substring match on 'test' would wrongly drop Nchuleftingth's Test of Pattern and Atestas' Pawn & Loan.

objectiveNotes.power: What the piece is for: armour rating on armour and shields, best damage on weapons, and enchantment capacity on clothing, which has no other purpose.
objectiveNotes.enchantment: Enchantment capacity, which decides what a constant effect can cost. Often a different item: Eleidon's Ward carries 30,000 points at 100 armour, while the best cuirass in the game has 100 armour at 1,500.
